# Callouts

GitHub alerts:

> [!NOTE]
> Useful information that users should know, even when skimming content.

> [!TIP]
> Helpful advice for doing things better or more easily.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Key information users need to know to achieve their goal.

> [!WARNING]
> Urgent info that needs immediate user attention to avoid problems.

> [!CAUTION]
> Advises about risks or negative outcomes of certain actions.

Obsidian callouts:

> [!tip]- A custom *title* on a folded callout
> The fold marker is ignored, and the body still prints.
>
> - Lists work
> - inside callouts

> [!question]+ Is this the warning family?
> Yes: question, help and faq look like warnings.

> [!bug] Only a title, no body

> [!example]
> Examples look like GitHub's IMPORTANT.

> [!quote] Ada Lovelace
> The Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves.

> [!mystery]
> An unknown type falls back to the note style.

> An ordinary blockquote stays a blockquote, [!note] and all.
